title: Late delivery partial refund
keywords: late delivery refund downgrade partial refund e-wallet credit job amendment
body: Downgrade the job to the service actually achieved (e.g. a 3-hr job delivered after 5 hrs → Same Day).
Deduct the difference from the agent; credit the customer's e-wallet via a job amendment.
Note: the exact price-amendment calculation is not yet in the knowledge base. Check the amended price with your lead before confirming an amount to the customer.
